# Creative Derivation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:CreativeDerivation`](gmeow-CreativeDerivation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/CreativeDerivation>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A reified relator binding a source creative work, a product creative work, one or more derivation types, and optional source/product segments. Tier-honest: a sample derives from a [`Recording`](gmeow-Recording.md) region, a cover is a new [`Expression`](gmeow-Expression.md), and 'same [`Work`](gmeow-Work.md)?' is a separate standpoint-indexed [`gmeow:realizes`](../properties/gmeow-realizes.md) claim (Principles 4, 9).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:CreativeDerivation`](gmeow-CreativeDerivation.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use when a derivation between two creative works must be first-class — its type(s), source/product segments, or provenance recorded — and when tier-honesty matters (a sample derives from a [`Recording`](gmeow-Recording.md) region, not the abstract [`Work`](gmeow-Work.md)).

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the flat 80% case (assert a shortcut like [`gmeow:coverOf`](../properties/gmeow-coverOf.md), [`gmeow:remixOf`](../properties/gmeow-remixOf.md), [`gmeow:samples`](../properties/gmeow-samples.md)) and avoid using it to assert 'same [`Work`](gmeow-Work.md)' — that is a separate standpoint-indexed [`gmeow:realizes`](../properties/gmeow-realizes.md) claim.

### How to use

- Mint the relator and bind [`gmeow:derivationSource`](../properties/gmeow-derivationSource.md), [`gmeow:derivationProduct`](../properties/gmeow-derivationProduct.md) (each functional), and one or more [`gmeow:derivationType`](../properties/gmeow-derivationType.md); pin source/product segments at the honest tier. It [`pairsWith`](../properties/gmeow-pairsWith.md) the flat [`wasDerivedFrom`](../properties/gmeow-wasDerivedFrom.md) shortcuts.

### Examples

- ex:d1 a [`gmeow:CreativeDerivation`](gmeow-CreativeDerivation.md); [`gmeow:derivationSource`](../properties/gmeow-derivationSource.md) ex:original; [`gmeow:derivationProduct`](../properties/gmeow-derivationProduct.md) ex:remix; [`gmeow:derivationType`](../properties/gmeow-derivationType.md) [`gmeow:derivationTypeRemix`](../individuals/gmeow-derivationTypeRemix.md).
